item.title: Tenshi no Hane o Fumanaide
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: MEPHISTO
  • 発売日: 2011-07-29
  • スコア: 7.68/10 (185 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天使の羽根を踏まないでっ
  • 英語名: Tenshi no Hane o Fumanaide

别名

  • Tenshihane

あらすじ

Over the course of history, there had been many prophets who predicted that the end of the world was near, but they were all just imposters. However, it really came true and people were at their wit’s end. Just like no one believed that the end of the world is near, the God that not many people believed in saved the world. It is in Saint Solyluna Academy that μ (Mu) is chosen – the only one that sits in the empty seat next to God and asks for salvation for mankind.
